thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> page fired SEV3: canary group 'warmup-v2' failing in eu-west-2. Alert: embed-service 5xx spike. https://pd.example/INCIDENT/1788 :pd: 

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: triggered by embed-service-error-rate > 2% over 5m. Pager: @sam-oncall -> @taylor-sre -> @maya-eng

sam-oncall: Acked. reading logs now.

taylor-sre: seeing p95 embed latency from 120ms -> 800ms and ~6% 503s on canary tasks. CPU ok, GPU mem normal. :thinking_face:

maya-eng: rolled out prewarm/kv-cache changes in this canary. Reproducing locally with warmup load - saw KV cache thrash leading to segfault retries

maya-eng: pushing logs: ```stderr: kv_cache invalidation failure: EBUSY while writing prefix; retry x3
[2026-03-17T01:02:12Z] shard=eu-west-2 id=canary-12 503 serve_request``` 

taylor-sre: good find. Is rollback of the change possible without impact? We can pause rollout and redirect traffic to stable variant

sam-oncall: @ops-shift-lead can you pause traffic and divert canary fraction -> 0? /rollout pause warmup-v2

ops-shift-lead: doing traffic-control now. `trafficctl set warmup-v2 0% --target stable-v1 --region eu-west-2` -> running

ops-shift-lead: API returned 202. Monitoring for drop in errors.

liz-cust-succ: I flagged to two customers on trial who hit errors; they reported intermittent failures. I'll open support tickets and patch text.

taylor-sre: after divert, error-rate dropping to 0.8% within 90s p50 back to baseline. :thumbsup:

maya-eng: initiating rollback of warmup change on canary artifact. `deployctl rollback warmup-v2 --to stable-v1` ETA ~2m

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation to SRE lead @taylor-sre for 15m. Autoresolve suspended until manual close.

sam-oncall: creating incident doc stub: /inc create canary-warmup-bounce eu-west-2

taylor-sre: adding runbook tag 'kv-cache' and start postmortem timer. Whoever owns quant-warmup, please join.

maya-eng: rollback complete on canary shard. healthchecks green. sample logs show no EBUSY.

ops-shift-lead: trafficctl confirm: warmup-v2 fraction=0%, all requests hitting stable-v1

liz-cust-succ: customers notified, support tickets created (#SUP-9123, #SUP-9124)

taylor-sre: pd-bot: resolving PagerDuty incident - verify stable for 5m then close.

pd-bot: Manual resolve requested by @taylor-sre. Waiting for final confirmation.

sam-oncall: 5m monitor window passed. p99 and error-rate normal across regions. I'm closing the page.

incident-bot: Page resolved. Incident record created INC-1788123. Follow-up: postmortem and action items assigned to maya-eng (kv-cache backoff) and eng-runtime (improved canary gating). :memo:

ops-shift-lead: handing off to next on-call @taylor-sre for postmortem, marking as stable. Good job team. :kudos:
